title: Katabasis
author: R.F. Kuang
summary: Two rival graduate students at a magical Cambridge descend into Hell to bring back their dead supervisor, whose recommendation each of them badly needs. It is a standalone mix of academic satire and underworld quest.
readIf: you like dark academia with a dry sense of humour and a mythic setting.
skipIf: you want a light or romantic read, since the tone is bleak and the characters are driven and prickly.

pairings.reason: The author's earlier novel, also about scholars, power and the price of ambition in a magical Oxford.
A classic of clever students whose obsession with their field leads them somewhere deadly.
Another intense circle of ambitious students, with a theatrical setting and a slow reveal.
